projectCopyEligible remains false.

Use a closed opaque near-black outer contour with no outer-edge wash, bleed, green/cyan/magenta fringe, or carrier contamination; preserve approved open-ink treatment inside the foreground.

Keep the entire subject inside bbox x=160..864, y=128..1376 with minimum margins L160/T128/R160/B160; target occupancy width 52-58% and height 68-74%; centered root, full visibility, no clipping, and separated readable lower legs and feet.
Use one later fresh route, prompt, and gmbuiltin1 scope; submitCount maximum 1, retryCount 0, then run the post-output hard gate before any next stage.
